objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Register on DVNA, use its network tool page to run a command on the server, and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The Learn page's A1 Injection entry links to a page that pings an address.
The address is appended to a shell command string in core/appHandler.js. Which vulnerability class does that allow?

steps.title: Find the page
steps.prompt: Which DVNA page runs a network command with your input? (its path)

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which form parameter is appended to that command?

steps.title: Name the flaw
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets a second command of yours run on the server?
